acceptanceCriteria: Every corvint-test-validity/0 test projection carries a repository-relative file, line and titlePath where the provider knows them, and an explicit absent marker otherwise.
Tests cover RSpec and Playwright projections, including a shared-group example.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1302 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. **Observed.** Each `tests[]` entry in `corvint-test-validity/0` has `id`, `name`, `package`, `state` and the projection axes, but no `file`, `line` or `titlePath`. Joining a verdict to a spec file needs a substring match on `id`/`name`, which is format-dependent (RSpec ids are `./spec/x_spec.rb[1:2]`; Playwright ids are opaque). **Wanted.** `file` (repository-relative), `line` and `titlePath` on every test projection. See beamfall/corvint#1302 for the full text.
title: Test-validity projections have no structured test location (issue #1302)
